statement: Revit 2027 acts as a Forma Connected Client in a tech preview, letting opted-in cloud models share data with other Forma applications through one common repository instead of file exchange.
superiority: Work offline with a local copy and sync when connected, which the cloud-only tool does not offer.

acceptance.sketch: Revit session connects to a test Forma project and lists its scenarios.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Revit does not open a Forma project as a client; cloud models stored in a project enabled for the preview connect to scenarios.

statement: List, reload, rename, delete and connect to Forma scenarios, which are shared design containers whose models and contextual data sets appear in the Manage Scenarios panel.
superiority: Show scenario history and diff in one panel.

acceptance.sketch: Scenario list equals the cloud list.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Scenarios are design containers that hold models and context, not analysis scenarios or proposals.

statement: Bring site context data (terrain, buildings, roads) from Forma into Revit as geolocated reference geometry.
superiority: Keep the context live-linked and diffable with a version history.

acceptance.sketch: Imported context aligns to the project location within 1 m.

statement: Run Forma wind estimate (fast predictive) or wind simulation (CFD) analyses from the Analyze tab and view comfort or direction results directly in the Revit view.
superiority: Run a local comparable analysis and show results with transparent assumptions.

acceptance.sketch: Overlay legend values match the Forma result.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Revit launches and displays wind analyses itself rather than importing prior results as overlays.

statement: Reference models from other Forma applications (such as site and building designs) alongside the geolocated Revit model in a scenario as lightweight coordination models, open them in their originating tool, or convert terrain to native Revit elements.
superiority: Make the handoff bidirectional so Revit edits flow back.

acceptance.sketch: Handoff model sits at the Forma site coordinates.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Docs describe coordination models and conversion of contextual data, not a native-model handoff of a building design from Forma.

statement: Sign in with an Autodesk ID, join a Forma Data Management project, and open its Revit cloud models from Revit Home, with the project administrator separately enabling the connected-client tech preview.

source.ref: Manage Forma Data Management Projects from Revit Home

superiority: Offer local-first sign-in with optional cloud.

acceptance.sketch: Signed-in user sees permitted projects only.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Docs describe project membership and Revit Home access; a hub picker is not described.

statement: Publish a model to Forma Data Management and share chosen 3D-view subsets as cloud Data Exchanges that other applications can load without receiving the whole model.
superiority: Open schemas published for every exchange.
notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Data exchange is a separate publish-and-share workflow from the connected-client scenario link.

statement: Revit is the first desktop application to be a Forma Connected Client, sharing a common data repository and schema so other applications can join the same workflows later.
superiority: Open connected-client framework for third-party tools.

acceptance.sketch: Two clients receive the same project data.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Help says Revit is first and more tools will follow; Civil 3D as a second client is not documented.

statement: Run Forma sustainability analyses from Revit (wind estimate and simulation, microclimate, daylight potential) and review results from the Analyses and History panel, with carbon analysis through Forma Carbon Insights.
superiority: Run equivalent analyses locally with open data.
notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Documented set is wind, microclimate (including sun hours), daylight potential and carbon; no noise analysis was found.

statement: Convert an ordered contextual data set such as terrain into native Revit elements (for example a toposolid) so it can be edited with the building.
superiority: Support convertible parcel and road data and larger extents.

acceptance.sketch: Order terrain for a small area, convert it, and verify a toposolid exists and the data set leaves the scenario list.

notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: feature found documented in Revit 2027 help during the verification pass; not in the original register

statement: Define an early-stage model location by searching an address, coordinates or map click, naming it and setting elevation, so scenario workflows can start before survey data exists.
superiority: Allow refinement into survey-accurate coordinates without breaking linked models.

acceptance.sketch: Set a draft location by address, connect to a scenario, and verify the model is geolocated there.

notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: feature found documented in Revit 2027 help during the verification pass; not in the original register

statement: Rate how much sky light reaches building facades as a vertical sky component percentage, allowing for shading from neighbouring buildings and terrain.
superiority: Run live as geometry changes and compare design options side by side.

acceptance.sketch: Place a taller neighbor mass and verify facade scores facing it drop.

notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: feature found documented in Revit 2027 help during the verification pass; not in the original register | reworded after overlap check
